title: Tenth siege of Gibraltar
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Tenth siege of Gibraltar", at revision 1374727345, opens: "The tenth siege of Gibraltar in 1506 was a minor military action in which the Duke of Medina Sidonia, Juan Alfonso Pérez de Guzmán tried but failed to recover the fortress of Gibraltar from the troops who were holding it in the name of the newly united crowns of Castile and Aragon." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q9078107, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1506 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
